fix(adapter): extract assistant text from openclaw's actual JSON shape

`openclaw agent --json` emits the response with `payloads` at the TOP
LEVEL of the dict, not under a `result` wrapper. The previous extractor
looked at `data["result"]["payloads"]`, found nothing, and silently
fell back to `str(data)` — which dumped the entire envelope into the
canvas chat as the assistant reply: bootstrap prompt, sessionId,
systemPromptReport (~26k chars), tool schemas, agent metadata, and
the raw provider/

fix(install): rename $pid param in install.ps1 to avoid PowerShell read-only var (#344)

In PowerShell, $pid is an automatic, read-only variable holding the
current session's process ID. The Wait-ForProcessExit parameter named
$pid shadowed it, causing the install command to fail with:

Rename the parameter (and its named-arg call site) to $ProcessId.

fix(litellm): num_retries=0 on chatgpt/ — stop double-burning rotated accounts

LiteLLM's router was retrying the same deployment once on any failure
including 429. The codex-auth-rotator can race that retry: when a
request hits a rate limit on account-N, the failure-callback writes
the rotate-now signal and the rotator swaps auth.json — but the
LiteLLM retry, scheduled 5s later, may now hit account-N+1 with the

openids with ret=-3. The stateless CC flow was stripping the suffix
in im_inbound, so every reply failed. NanoClaw's flow forwards chat_jid
intact, which is why it kept working.

behavior in Telegram's Send/SendImage so non-WeChat providers stay
correct now that the JID suffix reaches them.

Checkpoint: Fix: uploading m4a audio file for transcription failed

Root cause: m4a/mp4 containers store the moov atom (metadata) at the END of the file. ffmpeg cannot seek when reading from stdin pipe, so it exits with "moov atom not found" / no PCM output.

Fix: In xfyunTranscription.ts convertToPcm(), detect seekable formats (m4a, mp4, 3gp, mov) and write them to a temp file before running ffmpeg. Non-seekable formats (webm, ogg, mp3, wav, flac) continue to use the faster pipe approach.

two bytes are the JPEG SOI marker (0xFF 0xD8) and rejects the frame
otherwise. OV3660 (and likely other newer sensors) prepend a few
sync / padding bytes before the actual JPEG, so the strict check
fires every frame on the 2026 XIAO Sense batch — V4L2 logs hundreds
of "E:NO-SOI" per second and the dequeue loop starves the HTTP
server.

~1481 is already correct.
